keyFindings.description: A drain that stops early is never run again while the holder stays live. The exits are: the 20-forward budget, a failed forward (claim released but no new drain), a claim left to another drain inside the 60 s window, a bus error, and a shutdown. A keep runs only when no holder is live, and a live holder does not claim again, so copies 21 and later, and any left by those exits, wait for a later claim and usually expire. The PR body says such copies are delayed by at most a minute. No test covers more than 20 fresh copies or a failed forward with no later claim.

The drain forwards to the session it was started for and never checks that this session still holds the role. Concurrent hard claims all answer 200 and each starts a drain, so the first drain to win the cursor can hand every copy to a claimant the last write superseded. A takeover during a drain also leaves the rest of the budget going to the former holder, because the new holder's drain steps aside inside the claim window.

The census misses the Dispatch outbox's role route (internal/dispatch/outbox/publisher.go:1257-1264, published raw on the role lane, which now keeps it where it raised no_holder before) and packages/envoy-plugin/src/server.ts:146. The hard-claim change (concurrent hard claims all 200 where losers got 500) is in neither the body nor a changelog fragment.
The cursor write and owned check appear three times, and cursorSeq is carried by hand. A small lane type with write and release would remove the copies.

A forwarded kept copy is not counted in envoy_messages_delivered_total (architecture.md says role forwards count as delivered) and is not recorded in dedupeCache or attemptCache. A refused copy is counted through a switch copied from roleTopicDelivery. Share the refusal outcome and the forward finish (finishRoleForward).
migrateRoleLanesOffStream gives legacy notifications.> consumers newConfig.Subjects, which now carry the kept prefix. Pass the list without KeptTopicPrefix.
The role lane still keeps a raw publish to a role token that fails rolePattern. Apply isValidRole in roleKeepable so both give-up paths agree.
The 404 bullet leaves out two cases: a token that fails rolePattern, and a lapsed claim the restart grace retained.
The kept branch cannot be reached when the request sends keep:false. Delete it, or type EnvoyPublish so that answer.kept is read without an unknown probe.
Keep-then-drainAfterKeep is written at both give-up paths. Have the keep start the drain itself.
forwardKeptRoleMessage repeats listenerDeps.forwardAndWait. Make that a method of the delivery config and reuse it.
The claim window compares the listener's clock with the stream's store time, so clock skew moves the 60 s window. State it, or measure age against server time on both sides.
